c74object.name: evi_damp_coeffs
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Coefficients calculator for onepole damping filters
c74object.description:
evi_damp_coeffs is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_damp_coeffs.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
Coefficients calculator intended for Max schedular rate (in gen no tilde) for two evieve onepole damping/shelving filters. Used in many of the evieve reverb abstractions.

geninlet.digest: Dummy inlet to feed @param values in. Does nothing else.

attribute.name: HOST_SR
attribute.description: The real audio samplerate (not the samplerate of a gen no tilde object) must be passed in here for the coefficients calculations to work correctly.

attribute.name: cutoffhigh
attribute.description: High filter cutoff frequency in Hz.

attribute.name: cutofflow
attribute.description: Low filter cutoff frequency in Hz.

attribute.name: damphigh
attribute.description: High filter damping/shelving amount -1..1. Operation depends on @mode attribute.

attribute.name: damplow
attribute.description: Low filter damping/shelving amount -1..1. Operation depends on @mode attribute.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description: Mode of the coefficients calculations, affects damping/shelving and behaviour of @damplow and @damphigh attributes. If mode == 0: @damp attributes operate 0..1 only, with 0.==bypass, 1.==low or high passes (maximum damping), 0..1==shelving. If mode == 1: @damp attributes operate full range -1..1, with negative values shelf attenuate, positive values shelf boost, 0.==bypass. If mode == 2: @damp attributes operate full range -1..1, with -1.==low or high passes, negative values shelf attenuate, positive values shelf boost, 0.==bypass.
